Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 0
Reason for Mistake: Misapplied Wien’s law by stating hotter objects emit shorter wavelengths (blue) but then reversing the order, claiming blue is coolest and red is hottest. This contradiction led to selecting the wrong sequence (and even mismatching the option label), instead of the correct order blue > orange > red.
